_comment: Release automation config. minimumSupportedVersionCode: if omitted or 0, defaults to the new versionCode (fully mandatory). Set it LOWER than the new versionCode to allow older versions to keep working. releaseNotes: bullets shown on the update screen. You only edit THIS file and the versionCode/versionName in app/build.gradle.kts — the workflow generates version.json and the GitHub Release automatically.
releaseNotes: FIXED: export no longer freezes on 'Finalizing...' - verification now has its own visible stage and a time limit
FIXED: export failures now show the real reason instead of a frozen status and a dash for the percentage
Export state machine: Preparing > Optimizing > Audio > Rendering > Encoding > Finalizing > Verifying > Saving > Complete
The finished MP4 is read back and checked for a video track (and an audio track when you added music) before it is published
Percentage can no longer show a negative or invalid value
Restored the proven publish ordering from the last known-good export build
64 motion presets, 34 formula patterns, 32 transitions, 41 effects and 26 easing curves, each with its own card preview
